summary: Set a new password with a reset link

token.description: The token from the link of the mail (the part after #token=)

200.description: true when the password was set

400.description: The link is invalid or has expired, or the password is not valid

429.description: Too many requests from this address

description:
Sets the password of the user the token belongs to and uses the token up. Every session of the user ends; two-factor sign-in and API tokens stay. The action is audited as `password-reset` and a notice is mailed to the user. A bad token answers 400 `error.reset-invalid`. Shares the limit of POST /password-reset.

Needs: nothing (public)
